Title: Edyt: AI for text you can't even select. Any app on Mac & Windows | Product Hunt
# Edyt. ## AI for text you can't even select. AI in every app, on Mac and Windows. Select text, press one shortcut, and the result lands where your cursor is. Explain and Translate go as deep as you ask. Saved prompts run on anything you select and follow your account to every machine. Hold Option or Alt and drag over a PDF, screenshot, or shared screen. ### Launched Edyt today, AI for selected text in any app. It's a Mac and Windows app (Linux will come). You select text anywhere, press a shortcut, pick rewrite or explain or one of your own prompts, and the result replaces the selection. If the text can't be selected, like a PDF or a screenshot, you hold Option or Alt and drag over it instead. > Most AI tools come with a boundary: their own window, the browser only, one app, or one operating system. I could let prompts call MCP servers, so you select a customer name and a prompt pulls their last three tickets, or select a sentence in a spec and it checks it against your Linear issues. I'm not sure people would set that up for a text tool. If you already run MCP servers for something, what would you point a selected-text prompt at? Edyt puts AI on any text you select, in any app, on **Mac** and **Windows**. > **Edyt** works in every app you already use. It follows your own instructions, not a dropdown of three styles. * **Your saved prompts**, one keystroke away in every app, on any OS. Hold Option (or Alt) and drag over a PDF, a screenshot, or a shared screen, and the text is read on your device. Your prompts and settings live on your account. Sign in on another machine and Edyt sounds like you there too. Save as many as you like, run any of them with a keystroke in any app. And it works on text you can't select, like a PDF or a screenshot, by dragging over it. Quick question: can you share saved prompts with a teammate, or are they just tied to your own account for now?
